How do I start a return or an exchange?
To start a return:
If you’re in the UK, go to the returns portal, search for “Chillys,” enter your details, and choose your return method.
If you’re outside the UK, post your unused items (ideally via tracked/signed service) to the returns address on your despatch note.
For bundles, you must return the entire bundle, all items intact and unused. Customers cover return postage, and engraved items can’t be returned. Damaged or faulty items shouldn’t be sent back—hold onto them instead of returning.
